The county of the Women, Infants and Children (WIC) participant’s residence.  When residence address is unknown, WIC clinic address where the WIC participant was certified is used to determine county.  When neither residence nor clinic address are available, WIC agency address is used.  To ensure WIC participant anonymity, both Alpine and Sierra are excluded from this report.
The year and month for which participants were certified, or food benefits were issued or redeemed.

The type of participants. There are five participant categories in the Report 1 including:  Prenatal, Breastfeeding Individual, Non-Breastfeeding Individual, Infant, and Child. In the Report 3, the Child category has been broken down to four age groups as following: Prenatal, Breastfeeding Individual, Non-Breastfeeding Individual, Infant, and Child Aged 1 through Child Aged 4.

Number of participants who were certified in WIC for the year and month. For county or statewide annual count, it represents the average of 12 months of certified participant counts in the county or statewide. When participant count is less than 11, the cell was suppressed to ensure participant anonymity.

Number of participants who were issued food benefits for the year and month. For county or statewide annual count, it represents the average of 12 months of issued participant counts in the county or statewide. When participant count is less than 11, the cell was suppressed to ensure participant anonymity.
